question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Relevant
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'** i.e. **'Insignificant'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** 'Relevant' **typically means closely connected or appropriate to what is being done or considered. (संबंधित).

 
 
• **Example: **What are the relevant factors that we need to take into consideration?
 
 
 
• The antonym** 'Insignificant' **refers to something that is too small or unimportant to be worth consideration.(तुच्छ).
 
 
• **Example: **In the grand scheme of things, our problems are rather insignificant.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is **'Insignificant'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Ignorant'** as per Option 2 means lacking knowledge or awareness in general; uneducated or unsophisticated. (अज्ञानी)
 
• **'Compact**' as per Option 3 typically refers to an object or a person (used as an adjective) having all the necessary components or features neatly fitted into a small space.(संक्षिप्त)
 
• **'Applicable'** as per Option 4 suggests that something applying or relevant to a particular situation.(लागू होनेवाला)
